newsitem.title: USA: Mossimo names Mattel CFO to board.
newsitem.headline: Mossimo names Mattel CFO to board.

text.p: Mossimo Inc said it elected Francesca Luzuriaga, chief financial officer of Mattel Inc, to its board of directors, increasing the board to five members.

Luzuriaga, 42, is executive vice president and chief financial officer of Mattel. She joined Mattel in 1982 as a senior planning specialist and held several management positions before her appointment as chief financial officer.
Founded in 1987, Mossimo is a leading designer of men's and women's active wear and sports wear, with a focus on the contemporary, fashion-minded consumer.
